# OverlayConfig

> **File:** `config/OverlayConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Overlay: the configured views, plus the card grid's layout constants. (Named OverlayConfig because `Overlay` is the module type.)

### Properties

- `views` (readonly var)
- `size` (readonly int): Card size as a percentage of what fits the screen (see OverlayGrid)
- `monitors` (readonly string): "general" | "primary" | "focused" | "all" (see General.screensFor)
- `closeOnEscape` (readonly bool)
- `closeOnOutsideClick` (readonly bool)
- `pinnedPages` (readonly var): The pages that aren't in config, after the configured ones: the layouts editor (overlay pages and edge menus), which can't be removed.
- `availableModuleTypes` (readonly var)
- `libraryGroups` (readonly var): The groups the editors' libraries sort bar widgets and modules into (the schema's `x-libraryGroups`), in order
- `customViewSchema` (readonly var): A Custom page's own fields (name, icon, fineGrid), for the layouts editor
- `availableViewTypes` (readonly var)
- `cardUnit` (readonly int): Card grid layout (see GridPlacement for the geometry).
- `cardSpacing` (readonly int)
- `cardPadding` (readonly int)
- `fitCardsHigh` (readonly real): A screen fits this many cards across its free height / width; the smaller of the two sizes the cards, so height decides on landscape screens and width on portrait ones.
- `fitCardsWide` (readonly real)
- `minCardUnit` (readonly int)

### Functions

- `modulesFor(host)`: The module types a host's library offers: "overlay" pages, "edgeMenu"s or the "lockscreen" (required ones are always there)
- `requiredFor(host)`: The required module types on a host
- `isRequired(type)`
- `allowedIn(type, host)`
- `moduleInfo(type)`
- `viewInfo(type)`
- `viewLabel(view, index)`: How a page is named and drawn in the page navigator and the overlay editor: a Custom page by its name (or its place), others by type (i18n: keys from the schema's view labels)
- `pageKey(view)`: What opens a page by name (`openOverlayPage`, a bar Button or bind's `overlayPage` action): a Custom page's name, other pages' type; "" for a Custom page with no name
- `viewIcon(type)`
- `pageIcon(view)`: A page's icon: a Custom page's own, else its type's
- `isTool(type)`
- `pageWithModule(type)`: The page to open for a module type (what openOverlayPage takes): the named Custom page where it's biggest, "" when no page has it
- `cardPad(compact, bare)`: The inner padding a module lays its content out within (Card/Panel `pad`): none when bare, less in a quarter slot
- `cardUnitFor(width, height)`: The card size for `width` × `height` px of free space: what fits, capped at the reference cardUnit, then scaled by Overlay size
- `pageUnit(view, unit)`: The card size a Custom page's modules are laid out at on an overlay whose cards are `unit` px: a double grid's (fineGrid) has twice the units across (GridPlacement.fineUnit)
- `span(n, unit)`
- `slotShape(rect)`
- `defaultSize(type)`: The size [w, h] a module is added at: its declared one, else a card.
- `minSize(type)`: The least [w, h] a module dropped into a gap is shrunk to fit it: its declared one, else half its default size.
